youtube_description:
In this episode I metal detect the river beach in Coeur D Alene Idaho.  Not a ton of sounds, but I do manage to come up with several pieces of jewelry and 1 ends up being silver.  Back in Montana I hit the local park, I get a bunch more jewelry an old silver quarter and a super sweet g man ring.  The G man ring is from the 1930s a cracker jack prize and it has some pretty cool history to it.  I am detecting with my Minelab Equinox 800 and Stealth beach scoop.  #metaldetecting #Idaho #Montana

Want to know where we get our gear and what we use?  Support the channel and shop with some great folks at High Plains Prospectors use our affiliate links below.  We are super impressed with their selection and service.
